data_directory.description: Path to the directory containing etm data files (etm.cfg and *.etm files)

report_specifications.description: Ordered list of report format specifications (for 'm' command), each with a number and format string. Entry 1 is used by default for 'm 1'.

default_options.description: Key-value pairs defining default options for new items (e.g., for '=' entries in data files)
